run_prep_caption_cli: run the CLI tool to extract captions from tar shards in a webdataset directory
build_caption_from_tar: build caption JSON files from tarball shards by extracting matched image and text pairs
gather_captions_from_tarfile: gather captions from a tar file by pairing JSON text entries with matching image members
get_tarfile_path: get the organized tar file path for a given shard ID within a webdataset directory
main_multiprocess_shards: run the main function to process tar shards in parallel using multiprocessing Pool
